strategy: Not an EOA: an unverified shared multi-signer execution contract (22,852 bytes, nonce 1 = never sent a tx, 0 ETH balance) that a hard-coded whitelist of ~15 searcher EOAs drive through one entry point, selector 0x45499ab0 with a compact packed script payload (236 bytes for an Aave liquidation). The scripts do Aave v3 liquidations (Pool 0x794a61358d6845594f94dc1db02a252b5b4814ad, debt USDC/USDT0/DAI, collateral WETH/WBTC/WBTC/ARB/LINK) and Compound v3 AuctionCreator buy_collateral (0xd98be00b5d27fc98112bde293e487f8d4ca57d07), plus a much larger volume of Uniswap V3 (NPM 0xc6962004f452bE9203591991D15f6b388e09E8D0) / Trader Joe LBPM (0x360e68faccca8ca495c1b759fd9eee466db9fb32) swap-and-LP calls. The callers, not the contract, pay gas; only the whitelisted senders may call, so this is one collective's executor, not public keeper infrastructure.
